title: 10 · Mesh gradient · Prill
strengths: The gradient has a job: it is drawn from run #2,481's own cases (x = score, y = p95 latency, cyan = v13, violet = v14), labelled like a figure with a legend and score ticks, and the 37 regressions are the only cases drawn one by one, matching the table's '37 regressions' footer

The product is flat, whole and readable in front of a contained, hard-edged plate: an eval table with thresholds, v13/v14 values and coloured deltas, 'Release blocked · 2 of 7 checks below threshold' said once in text
Light 300 display headline with no highlight, one action, a facts row ('4,012 cases, 6 min') instead of logos or ratings
All text sits on white or on a solid ground strip; the failing contrast on the field (ticks at 1.75:1) was measured and moved
slop_signals: Blue-to-violet glow behind the product, the most common AI tell (rules.md section 10), in the same layout as Cursor's and Vanta's heroes
A white table card floating on the gradient panel beside a headline, sub-line, dark button and three facts: the default SaaS hero
The 'field generated from seeded data' cannot be read as data; the cluster of white dots at the bottom reads as sparkles
fixes: Move off blue-violet: one hue family tied to pass and fail, or a neutral field with one warm signal for the regressions
Either make the field a readable chart (axes and labels on the field itself) or drop it and let the table carry the hero
Fix the check count and the regression count (below)

references.what: A multi-colour mesh behind the product screenshot: the recipe this piece repeats
A purple glow under a floating card, the AI-default look
An AI analysis hero with the product shown flat on a dark grid, no gradient

changed: Renamed Assay to Prill (Assay is an open-source LLM-evaluation library); web search found no AI-evaluation product called Prill

Palette off blue-violet: white page, graphite field, one molten orange signal with an amber core; engine brandColor #F0570A, graphite and amber secondaries, pick Q-dir-01 mesh-gradient builds the gradient tokens

Gradient rebuilt as a readable chart inside the product: each case by v13 and v14 answer-correctness score, axes 0.2 to 1.0, equal-score line, keyed density; the 117 regressions are the orange cloud and the only dots; plotted means equal the table's 0.861 and 0.893
No card floating on a plate: headline and lede above, the run flat and whole in the grid; facts row removed; one action
Gate reads 1 of 6 checks; 117 newly failing and 8 newly passing (3,924 to 3,815 passes); v14 is a new prompt and a smaller model; run time 14:37
Mark is a flat bead, no gradient
